faqs.q: What is included in the free plan?
faqs.a: The free plan includes Ask Rin-chan, PDF-to-quiz generation, personalized paths and exercises, public quizzes, and progress tracking. Each AI capability has its own quota shown on your profile.

Premium unlocks the full curated Quiz Premium catalog and higher AI usage limits. Free accounts can permanently unlock individual Premium quizzes with credits earned from approved contributions. You make a one-time payment for the access period shown at checkout; it does not renew automatically, and your Premium access remains active until the displayed expiry date.

faqs.q: Can I switch plans at any time?
faqs.a: Yes. You can purchase a premium plan whenever you are ready. Your current access remains until it ends.

faqs.q: Is there a student or educator discount?
faqs.a: There is no public student or educator discount at this time. Educators can contact support@rinkuzu.app to register interest in future classroom pilots.

cta.title: Not sure which plan is right for you?
cta.subtitle: Start with the free plan, no credit card required. Upgrade anytime.
